messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.5.5

1.5.5. Extreme temperatures Steps shall be taken to eliminate any risk of injury arising from contact with or proximity to machinery or related product parts or materials at high or very low temperatures. The necessary steps shall also be taken to avoid or protect against the risk of hot or very cold material being ejected.

response.text:
Steps | shall eliminate | any risk of injury from contact with or proximity to machinery or related product parts or materials at high or very low temperatures | | Steps shall be taken to eliminate any risk of injury arising from contact with or proximity to machinery or related product parts or materials at high or very low temperatures.
Necessary steps | shall avoid or protect against | risk of hot or very cold material being ejected | | The necessary steps shall also be taken to avoid or protect against the risk of hot or very cold material being ejected.
